subject.title: Feature Request: Extract text from document attachments in Telegram channel

question: What Office-document extraction boundary should OpenClaw support for Telegram and shared attachment context?
rationale: The remaining gap is source-proven, but parsing untrusted Office containers changes dependency, MIME, resource-limit, availability, and prompt-injection boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Bound shared extractor support
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved DOCX/XLSX/PPTX subset through the shared document-extractor and media-understanding path with explicit archive/XML limits and security tests.

options.title: Keep Office external for now
options.body: Leave core at text/PDF extraction and document a ClawHub, MCP, or plugin companion path until maintainers approve an in-process Office parser boundary.

options.title: Defer to provider-native design
options.body: Fold this into the broader provider-native document/file forwarding design rather than adding local Office extraction first.

recommendation.title: Bound shared extractor support
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved DOCX/XLSX/PPTX subset through the shared document-extractor and media-understanding path with explicit archive/XML limits and security tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history signal is on the document-extractor and input_file seams this decision would extend.
